implementation.new_table: position_declarations(observation_id PRIMARY KEY FK position_observations.id, declared_at, origin explicit_user_declaration)
explicit_entrypoints: Harness.set_company_status(..., held=True|False), including existing CLI company set-status --held|--no-held
Store.declare_position as explicit caller declaration API
not_declaration_entrypoints: ingest held omitted or explicitly supplied
implementation.clock: declare_position takes trusted runtime now only after entering _record_write (BEGIN IMMEDIATE or nested SAVEPOINT); no caller JSON observation timestamp is added. now injection is trusted runtime/test input.
implementation.atomicity: Current company held metadata, new observation, and receipt are in the same transaction/savepoint. Harness status update is in the outer transaction. Same-value explicit declarations always append new observations; old rows receive no retrofit receipts.
implementation.decision_boundary: DecisionLifecycle.position_for calls declared_position_at. Latest observation at as_of must itself have explicit_user_declaration receipt with declared_at<=as_of; no fallback to earlier receipt-qualified observations. Missing/unknown yields None and existing unknown position guards. Existing synthetic_position scope remains unchanged.
implementation.metadata_compatibility: Existing position_at returns metadata history/kind observed. Company held defaults and provider preservation and queue priorities are unchanged. Explicit ingest held is still metadata, not a user holding declaration. This is an intentional decision eligibility boundary.
implementation.declaration_semantics: Declared view: kind user_declaration, origin explicit_user_declaration, declared_at and broker_verified:false. It records caller assertion, not broker verification.
implementation.old_records: No company/position/history migration UPDATE or origin backfill. Existing company JSON changes only through intentional existing status updates or the explicit declaration API. Frozen contracts, old thesis/policy/evaluation JSON remain untouched. Bootstrap metadata observation stays compatible and produces no declaration receipt.
implementation.pure_CLI: Snapshot-only decision/ir-plan calculators retain caller-supplied snapshot context; this change does not add live DB/holdings verification to those routes.
